cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
import compiler
from harness import check_plan

random.seed(11)
N = 48
PARTS = list(range(32))
ORD = list(range(32, 48))
links = []
seen = set()
def add(u, v):
    key = (min(u, v), max(u, v))
    if key in seen or u == v: return
    seen.add(key); links.append((u, v))
# hubs interconnected in a ring
for i in range(len(ORD)):
    add(ORD[i], ORD[(i + 1) % len(ORD)])
# each participant attaches to two hubs
for p in PARTS:
    add(p, ORD[p % len(ORD)])
    add(p, ORD[(p * 7 + 3) % len(ORD)])
print('links', len(links))
demands = {p: random.randrange(1, 6) for p in PARTS}
envelope = {i: 5 for i in range(len(links))}
period = 4
caps = {l: period * r for l, r in envelope.items()}
cut, deficit = compiler.find_deficient_cut(N, links, caps, PARTS, demands)
print('deficit', deficit)
t0 = time.time()
plan = compiler._try_variant(N, links, envelope, period, PARTS, demands, 'relay')
print('relay ->', 'plan' if plan else None, '%.2fs' % (time.time() - t0))
if plan:
    ok, why = check_plan(plan, N, links, caps, PARTS, demands, period, envelope)
    print('valid', ok, why)
    print('trees', len(plan['trees']), 'routes', len(plan['routes']), 'recipes', len(plan['recipes']))
    loads = compiler._plan_loads(plan, links)
    print('max load', max(loads.values()), 'cap', period * 5)
PYEOF
